ValidationRule.description: DIR-1128/DIR-869 DOA: Blocks submitting a Quote for approval (Status -> Pending Approval) when the Quote owner (RM/Specialist) has no manager set on their user record, so the DOA approval can route to the Sales Manager.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Status), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Pending Approval"), ISBLANK( Owner:User.ManagerId ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot submit this quote for approval because a manager is not set on the owner's user record. Please ask your administrator to assign a manager before submitting for approval.
